billing.description: Your plan, screens and payments. Payments are handled by WallX; invoices are sent to you separately.
billing.noAccessBody: Ask an owner of the organization for billing details.
billing.none: There is no subscription yet. It starts when the organization is approved.

statusHelp.trialing: Everything works during the trial. Contact WallX (Request a change) to choose a paid plan before it ends.
statusHelp.active: Your subscription is paid and active.
statusHelp.past_due: The paid period has ended. Renew within the grace period to avoid interruption; everything still works until then.
statusHelp.restricted: Editing and publishing are paused because the subscription lapsed. Screens keep playing their current content. Contact WallX to renew.
statusHelp.cancelled: The subscription has ended. Screens keep playing their last content; editing and publishing are paused.

billing.requestHelp: WallX billing will contact you to confirm the change and the payment.
billing.requestSent: Request sent. WallX billing will get back to you.
billing.viaReseller: Your plan and screens are provided by {{name}}. Contact them for changes, invoices and payments.

billingBanner.trialEnding: Your free trial ends on {{date}}. Choose a plan to keep editing and publishing.
billingBanner.pastDue: Payment is due. Renew by {{date}} to avoid interruption.
billingBanner.restricted: Your subscription has lapsed: editing and publishing are paused. Screens keep playing their current content.
billingBanner.cancelled: Your subscription has ended: editing and publishing are paused. Screens keep playing their last content.
billingBanner.resellerPastDue: Payment is overdue. Contact {{name}} before {{date}} to keep editing and publishing.
billingBanner.resellerRestricted: Editing and publishing are paused. Your screens keep playing. Contact {{name}} to restore them.

adminBilling.description: Subscriptions of every organization and requests from customers. Payments are recorded here; invoices are issued in the invoicing app.
adminBilling.legacy_one: {{count}} subscription was created before billing existed and is not monitored yet.
adminBilling.legacy_other: {{count}} subscriptions were created before billing existed and are not monitored yet.
adminBilling.noSubscription: This organization has no subscription yet (it is not approved).
adminBilling.orgDescription: Subscription, payments and entitlements. Every change is audited with its reason.
adminBilling.cancelBody: The subscription stays active until {{date}} and then ends without a grace period.
adminBilling.undoCancelBody: The subscription will continue (and need renewal) as normal.
adminBilling.entitlementsHelp: What the organization may use now: plan, screens purchased and any overrides.
adminBilling.overridesHelp: Overrides apply on top of the plan for this organization only (pilots, enterprise deals). Planned features stay off until released.
adminBilling.resolveHelp: Make the change first (plan, screens, payment), then mark the request done. The customer is notified.
adminBilling.voidBody: {{amount}} received on {{date}} will be marked void (e.g. a bounced cheque). The paid-through date is not changed; adjust it separately if needed.
adminBilling.reasonHint: At least 5 characters. Saved in the audit log.
adminBilling.customPriceHint: Leave empty to use the plan price.
adminBilling.paymentHelp: Record money already received. The paid period is extended from the current paid-through date (or from today if it lapsed).
adminBilling.datesHelp: Change the trial end or the paid-through date (goodwill extension, correction after a voided payment). Clear a date to remove it.

adminFeatures.description: Plans, prices and limits, and which features are released. Changes apply to every organization on the plan.
adminFeatures.editWarning: Saving recomputes the entitlements of every organization on this plan. Existing subscription prices are recalculated the next time each subscription is changed.
adminFeatures.planIdHint: Lowercase, e.g. retail-pro. Cannot be changed.
adminFeatures.limitsHint: Empty = unlimited. Screens empty = the number of screens purchased.
adminFeatures.releaseHelp: A feature is usable only when it is released (GA) and in the plan; beta features only when granted to an organization.

releaseEffect.planned: The feature is switched off for every organization.
releaseEffect.beta: Only organizations with an explicit grant can use it.
releaseEffect.ga: Every organization whose plan includes it can use it.

adminApps.description: What WallX sells as apps, the price of each and what it costs to run. Customers start buying apps in a later phase.
adminApps.seeded_one: {{count}} app added from the starting catalog.
adminApps.seeded_other: {{count}} apps added from the starting catalog.
adminApps.unsold: Not sold in any app yet: {{list}}.
adminApps.phaseNote: Phase 1: this catalog does not change what customers get or pay yet. Plans still decide that until bills move to apps (phase 2).
adminApps.notes: Prices and costs are per unit per month, before GST. Margin is green at {{margin}}% or more. Availability follows the release status of the app’s features (Features & plans).
adminApps.idHint: 2–40 lowercase letters, digits or -. Cannot be changed later.
adminApps.name: Name
adminApps.dealerHint: Leave empty to use each reseller’s discount.
adminApps.dealerError: Enter rupees, not more than the price.
adminApps.costHint: Estimated cost to WallX per unit (see the price sheet).
adminApps.baseLabel: Base app: included with every screen
adminApps.reasonHint: At least 5 characters; recorded in the audit log.

appBilling.trialAllApps: Every app is free during your trial (until {{date}}). After it, you keep the apps below.
appBilling.linesNote: Annual billing and any agreed discount are applied to this monthly total; GST is added.
appBilling.pricingModeHint: By apps: screens at the base price plus the apps chosen below. Prices are locked when an app is added.
appBilling.moveTrial: This organization is in its trial, so there is no price to keep. These apps match its plan:
appBilling.moveSamePrice: The customer keeps paying {{amount}} per month: the apps match the plan, and an adjustment keeps the price.
appBilling.adjustmentHint: E.g. to keep a migrated customer’s price. Leave empty for none.
appBilling.reprice: Move app lines to today’s catalog prices
appBilling.planBasePrice: Base price per screen with app pricing (₹, optional)
appBilling.planBasePriceHint: For organizations billed by apps. Empty = the Screen app price.

appStore.description: Choose how many screens you pay for and which apps they run. Each app has its own monthly price.
appStore.viaReseller: Your apps are provided by {{name}}. Contact them to add or remove apps.
appStore.planPricing: Your plan includes its features on every screen. To choose apps one by one, ask WallX to move you to app pricing (Billing → Request a change).
appStore.trial: Every app is free during your trial (until {{date}}). Choose what you want to keep; changes are free until then.
appStore.scheduledShort: Some screens or apps end on {{date}} (chosen in the App store).
appStore.pending: {{amount}} (plus GST) for apps added this period will be added to your next payment.
appStore.ownerOnly: Only the organization owner can change apps.
appStore.screensHelp: {{price}} per screen per month ({{name}}: media, layouts, widgets, emergency messages, monitoring).
appStore.tooFewScreens: You use {{count}} screens; remove screens before buying fewer.
appStore.placeHint: Apps bought for some screens run on the screens you choose.
appStore.summaryNote: Before the annual or agreed discount; GST is added.
appStore.removingOn: Removed on {{date}} (end of the paid period)
appStore.reviewTrial: You are in your trial: these changes are free. After the trial you pay for what you keep.
appStore.chargeNote: (for the {{pct}}% of this period that is left)
appStore.reviewNote: Removals take effect at the end of the paid period; there are no refunds. Prices exclude GST.
appStore.doneCharged: Your apps are updated. {{amount}} is added to your next payment.
appStore.open: Change screens and apps in the App store
appStore.staffPending_one: App store: {{amount}} from {{count}} change to collect with the next payment.
appStore.staffPending_other: App store: {{amount}} from {{count}} changes to collect with the next payment.
appStore.staffScheduled: App store: on {{date}}: {{list}}. Changing the plan or lines replaces this.

adminCosts.description: What each organization and app earns against what it costs WallX to run, from measured usage and your unit costs.
adminCosts.summaryNote: Revenue is the monthly price before GST (reseller customers at the dealer discount; trials earn nothing). Margin uses the projected cost.
adminCosts.none: No usage rolled up for this month yet. The daily job adds yesterday every morning.
adminCosts.note: Usage is counted per UTC day and rolled up each morning; today appears tomorrow. Cloud prices ignore free tiers, so real costs are lower while you are small. Staff costs, hardware and sales are not included.
adminCosts.ratesHint: What each unit costs WallX, before GST. Starting values come from the phase 0 price sheet; update them when Google prices or the dollar rate change.

rates.perGbDelivered: Per GB of media delivered to screens
rates.perOrgMonth: Fixed cost per organization per month

payOnline.title: Pay online
payOnline.note: Pay securely with UPI, card or netbanking through Razorpay. WallX sends the tax invoice separately.
payOnline.paidUntil: Payment of {{amount}} received. You are paid through {{date}}. Thank you!
payOnline.failed: The payment did not go through. You can try again.
payOnline.recordedLater: If money was taken, it is recorded automatically within a few minutes.
payOnline.checkoutBlocked: The payment window could not load. Check your connection or ad blocker and try again.

appLock.soon: {{app}} is coming soon. WallX will let you know when you can add it.
appLock.available: Add the {{app}} app in the App store to use this.
appLock.askOwner: Ask your organization’s owner to add the {{app}} app in the App store.
